51587179.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to biotinylated Keap1 Kelch domain (unknown origin) by SPR method

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: SPR Direct Binding Assay. SPR experiments were carried out on a Biacore S51 instrument (GE Healthcare) at 25 °C. Streptavidin chips (GE Healthcare) were used to immobilize the biotinylated Keap1 Kelch domain. Each streptavidin chip was pretreated with three consecutive injections of 50 mM NaOH in 1 M NaCl. Biotinylated Keap1 Kelch domain (2.5–5 μg/mL) in HBS-EP+ buffer was injected for 1–5 min. Typical immobilization levels ranged from 1600 to 2300 resonance units. The compounds were diluted directly into the running buffer containing 5% DMSO. Using the multicycle or single-cycle kinetics method, serially diluted compounds were injected sequentially for a 1 min association followed by 2–10 min dissociation at a flow rate of 30 μL/min. To obtain binding constants, the measured raw data were DMSO corrected, double-referenced, and fit to a 1:1 binding model including a mass transfer limitation term using Biacore Evaluation software (GE Healthcare).

Values of CD are mean values determined from two replicates. Reported compound 313a was used as a positive control, and mean IC50 values (SD) were 11.9 μM (±2.9, n = 8). eThe Clog P value was calculated using software from ChemAxon. fMS: metabolic stability in liver microsomes after 60 min incubation. gHERG currents were measured by a patch clamp assay (IonWorks Quattro). hInhibitory activities were evaluated using six CYP isoforms (CYP3A4, 1A2, 2C8, 2C9, 2C19, 2D6).
